notes.title: Bug Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Every now and then some little updates will appear for the RATUZ game. I've been working to fix all the bugs the community is reporting.

If you find more Bugs, please let us know in the Steam discussions or on our Discord Server.

Thank you all for the feedbacks and I apologize for the bugs. ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: RATUZ is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]RATUZ is OUT NOW![/b] 🥳

After a science experiment gets out of control, you need to survive and escape this dark prison that hides weird secrets.

[b]Share[/b] or [b]RATUZ[/b] will get you! 🐭

We hope you like it and have fun. Don't forget to leave your [b]review[/b] if you enjoyed the game. ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: RATUZ | Developers playing (Gameplay)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39889507/5fedbdf4caa0e085cbdd03067454297b634faa93.png[/img]

Developers will play their RATUZ game, showing the DEMO and answering questions in the chat. We will not be speaking into the microphone, so it will only be answered via chat/text.

We hope to receive some feedback, whether positive or negative so that we can improve the game.

We intend to create 4 ou 5 acts and we will improve our scenery, background and animations. The game will have different endings depending on some decisions you make.

Don't forget to follow us on our social media to follow the evolution and development of the game we should finish later this year or early next year!

[h2]About the game[/h2]

[b]Description:[/b] 

After a science experiment gets out of control, you need to survive and escape this dark prison that hides weird secrets. The game is a cinematic platform of terror and stealth, inspired by INSIDE, Another World, Blackthorne and Heart of Darkness.

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Immersing horror sci-fi story
[*] Dark and tense atmosphere
[*] Abominable creatures created in scientific experiments on humans.
[*] Rich in history and animations
[*] Moments of persecution and stealth
[*] Multiple endings
[*] Puzzles
[/list]
[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550840/RATUZ/] Steam Link [/url][/h3]

[hr][/hr]
For more information about the game and the development team, visit our website: [url=https://badcoffeegames.com]https://badcoffeegames.com[/url]

Thank you very much and let's play!
